correctness.rationale: The face classification removes exactly b triangles per new intrashore edge, no other faces. The complement of any linear forest on at least four vertices is connected. Explicit fan-plus-simplex disks nullhomotope every attaching loop, yielding a relative wedge splitting and primitive integral H2 injections. The cofiber is the signed oriented-edge lattice tensored with opposite-shore vertices; integral exactness and ordinary splitting follow. The unperturbed complex is simply connected and has free H2 of the Euler-characteristic rank R. Every critical step is an all-size argument, independently corroborated by 98 finite graph enumerations and signed integer fillings; finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The exact integral effect of arbitrary sequences of intrashore linear-forest edge additions is a natural topological robustness invariant: precisely one degree-two class per opposite-shore vertex is lost, with primitive maps and explicit equivariant orientation information. This cannot be recovered from stagewise Betti numbers alone and applies uniformly to an infinite family, with the sharp connected-complement boundary made explicit.
